name: @minimalist-alliance/maia-avatar
description: Maia, version 7, animated on Canvas 2D: createAvatar, <maia-avatar> and parseScore. No framework and no runtime dependencies. See README.md.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --mode score && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && node scripts/finish.mjs
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run build:demo && node scripts/serve.mjs --port ${MAIA_PORT:-5184}
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run build:demo && playwright test --project chromium
scripts.screenshots: npm run build && npm run build:demo && playwright test --project screenshots
scripts.dance:capture: npm run build && npm run build:demo && playwright test --project capture
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run e2e
